Model guide: docs/models/65U8HAU/V0000.06.29X.P0813/. Verified on 65U8HAU (AU / EM_C, transport_protocol=3160, region=0; Hisense_Get* reports MTK9900, U06.29, board 65E83GAVT, serial type 65U8H). Unformatted 12-hex macWifi is rejected with rc=133; uppercase colon-separated TV_MAC with the 'standard' profile connects (rc=0) using the 2024 VidaaAppAndroidV01 cert (res/El.p12). PIN dialog closes after ~30 s; reconnecting with password=accesstoken enables full MQTT actions (state, 7-item sourcelist, 45-item applist, launchapp for appId 16 'TV Browser', server-side custom launcher registration + Home-watcher bounce). Browser exposes WebSDK_createFileRequest / WebSDK_createLibRequest / WebSDK_hiSecurity / opera_omi + 66 Hisense_Get* (HiUtils_createRequest and Hisense_installApp absent). localhost:9009 C++ UI service enforces an origin gate on /file/* (4 mode bases 0..3) and /hiSecurity/* while leaving /tvapi/initialData and /tvapi/deviceCode ungated; LAN 9226 unfiltered (ECONNREFUSED) while 9222-9224 are firewall-dropped. Root blocked at that origin gate.

capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/65U7H/V0000.06.29X.P0813/. Started on V0000.06.21U.N1023, upgraded to V0000.06.29X.P0813 mid-research. Different bridge surface from the U9 generation: no HiUtils_createRequest, instead WebSDK_createFileRequest -> POST localhost:9009/file/<api>, origin-gated to vidaahub.com (works over plain HTTP too). Mode bases 0=/tmp, 2=channelA, 6=/APPS, 7=/OAD. The file service is fragile: reading binaries NUL-truncates, and POSTs to /hiSecurity/* kill the handler with nothing supervising it back. rc.local ships the /var/local/otaTest.sh call commented out. The U9 hiutils API table is absent on this build. Contributed by pavanjadhaw; see issue #2 for the running dialogue.

capability_detail.file_bridge_write: Same WebSDK route as traversal; binary reads NUL-truncate and POSTs to /hiSecurity/* kill the handler with nothing supervising it back.
capability_detail.root: No exec door found on this build — bridge reads and writes, rc.local ships the /var/local/otaTest.sh call commented out, and /hiSecurity/* POSTs kill the handler. WIP (contributed by pavanjadhaw; issue #2).

capabilities.notes: Pairing required the TV's real Wi-Fi MAC (a placeholder/random MAC is silently rejected at the MQTT layer; TLS completes but auth fails). self-install lane verified blocked: HiUtils fileWrite on websdk/Appinfo.json -> 503 'client request permission check error, please check appconfig' (fileRead ret=true returned {"AppInfo":[]}, unchanged after failed write). launcher end-to-end verified via Mac-side custom-app fallback + home-state transition broadcasts; gettvstate does NOT answer on this build (state stays null; only transition broadcasts + periodic sourcelist push), re-launching an identical custom app is deduped and needs a URL variant (?v=2). fileRead is a strict /APPS/ path joiner (no escape found). Bridge surface from a plain http page: 108 platform names on window, 85 Hisense_Get* callable; GetDeviceCode masked '000000' in page scope; getter error paths accept injected text -> read/oracle primitive only, no write privilege. Root: the browser file bridge stayed closed; the write primitive is the FaaS fetcher (basic/fetcher fetchFile, uid 314), which is a different surface from file_bridge_write. 'Architecture: mtk9603' read from the device's own opkg.conf, not from model docs; opkg status DB at /APPS/pkgs/opkgmeta/status. Persistence: a two-file service in an already-rw vendor package plus one serviceList.json entry, run by the vendor service manager at every boot as uid 314 (proven across a power-cycle). Model guide: docs/models/43Q60SEVS/V0000.09.60W.Q0612/.

capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/50A6Q/V0000.09.61B.Q0721/. First Novatek entry, first aarch64 unit. Traversal closed; fetcher (empty permission block) is the writer; in-process ISC bypasses all gated APIs; the PFM debug framework evals PFMCheck lines as root at boot; dropbear gauntlet same five locks as MTK, patched at source (MULTIUSER=0 builds kill every connection child with 'String too long' — ship MULTIUSER=1); hostkeys must be dropbear-native format; a runtime watchdog deletes the gate flag and the old IPK lane clobbered PFMCheck — both countered by a 10 s re-plant loop.

capabilities.notes: Model guide: docs/models/75U8QTUK/V0000.09.60I.Q0813/. Fingerprint captured 2026-11-06 (owner-verified): firmware, Extended/Minor/RC versions, SoC, kernel arch, UA, locale, LAN nmap posture — findings/00. Same firmware id as the EU_A 100U7Q row (V0000.09.60I.Q0813); country GBR but internal region EU_A. Chain shape differs from 100U7Q only in the browser surface: hiutils fileRead needs an array path and the writer is basic/fetcher fetchFile (findings/05); the FaaS helper runs as uid 314/gid 314 with supplemental group 616 and reaches /var/run/superwatch_socket (findings/06). Arm: static ARM32 Dropbear 2022.83 (zig musl) + minimal IPK written via fetchFile, installed with superwatch 83+82; the postinst logged Uid 0 and CapEff 000001ffffffffff (findings/07). Persistence timeline: findings/08 measured no autostart after a real reboot (83+82 restored uid 0 with the same host key, no re-download); findings/11 automated the re-arm as a re_sshd service and confirmed it over a supervised reboot — downtime ~52 s, SSH back at uptime 16.39 s, no browser in the loop, re-applied after a second reboot. Native DOM Home (v2) was installed and owner-verified across that same reboot (findings/09, /10, /11). State left on the TV: /APPS/.re_sshd, /APPS/shell, /APPS/installer.ipk, the sw2.js FaaS helper, package re.installer, ptmx 0666, one FIREWALL_IN_EULAON ACCEPT dpt:8008. Teardown: findings/09 (Home), findings/11 (persistence hook).

capability_detail.launcher: Native DOM Home replaces the /Launcher route component in the writable operation-ui app.js, preserving the vendor lifecycle and routes; app list, inputs, TV Settings and app launch confirmed on screen. v2 merges apps and inputs into one list and adds CSS-gradient wallpapers (findings/09, findings/10); the swap survived a reboot (findings/11). Rollback is one command.
capability_detail.file_bridge_traversal: hiutils.fileRead traverses only with an array path: path:['../proc/uptime'] returns ret:true, while bare-string paths are rejected 'invalid path' (findings/05).
capability_detail.file_bridge_write: The write primitive is the FaaS fetcher: basic/fetcher fetchFile returns ret:true 'download finished', with markers written to /APPS and /APPS/pkgs/tv.vidaa.jsservice.basic/CHA/ (findings/05).
capability_detail.root: The 100U7Q chain armed 2026-11-06 (owner-authorized): the IPK postinst ran as uid 0 with CapEff 000001ffffffffff and ssh -p 8008 (dedicated ed25519 key in server/keys/, gitignored) gives uid 0 + PTY, with /etc/shadow and /data readable. Boot persistence achieved 2026-11-07: the re_sshd service re-arms SSH automatically at every boot — a supervised reboot at uptime 84000 s returned SSH at uptime 16.39 s with no browser re-arm (findings/11). The earlier state of this row (no autostart; re-arm with superwatch 83+82) was the pre-findings/11 measurement from findings/08. Teardown: findings/09 (native Home) and findings/11 (persistence hook).

capabilities.notes: Launcher lane only, 2026-11-06. Pairing: 2024 VidaaAppAndroidV01 cert (res/El.p12 from com.universal.remote.multi 1.09.05.001.0) + modern credentials; colon-formatted MAC required (12-hex form returns rc 135); PIN accepted, tokenissuance issued, and two-way actions (state/gettvstate/applist/sourcelist/launchapp) answered. Launcher page + /ws + icon proxy + server-side watcher bounce verified end-to-end; /api/open must launch appId 16 'Browser' with an overridden url - a custom appId (vidaa-recon / vidaa-home) is silently ignored on this build. capabilities.notes: MTK9603 / U09.09, UK, on the same 09.09 branch as 55A7KAU but a different P-code letter and SoC. Pairing needs the VidaaAppAndroidV01 client cert and a colon-formatted macWifi; the SSDP mac field is the wrong NIC on this wireless unit. The file bridge is open for both traversal and write, and the 503 appconfig gate seen on 43A5LE does not apply on this branch. Root is boot-persistent through the re_sshd serviceList autostart, with OTA frozen in the postinst and re-applied each boot. Every-boot DNS coverage is currently blocked by the re-arm failure states in findings/09; without SSH, re-trigger phase3-arm14.html on a healthy boot. Chain, teardown and evidence: docs/models/55E7QTUK/V0000.09.09D.P1001/findings/ (00-09).

Model guide: docs/models/50A7HAU/V0000.06.12X.N1212/. Read-only fingerprint only, no write probes. Internal board 50A6GA per UPnP dd.xml. transport_protocol 3290 decoded from the UDN ASCII payload, which is notable because the earlier 65U8HAU U6 report was 3160, so this build carries the newer pairing handshake. Bridge expected to be the WebSDK_* origin-gated family rather than HiUtils. Ports: 3366 UPnP open, 36669 MQTT with mTLS enforced, 36670 companion TLS open, 9009 loopback-bound, 9222-9226 filtered, 22/2222/2323/8008/5555 closed. ICMP dropped, SSDP multicast unanswered, direct unicast to :3366/dd.xml works.

Retail 55E7NQ PRO, internal 55E75LEVS, serial type 55E75LE, EU_A/BIH, transport_protocol 3290. MTK9618/mt5879 with aarch64 kernel but 32-bit ARM userland (process.arch 'arm'), so the kit is armhf. Reached from the TV Browser page: fetcher writes, hiutils array-path traversal, superwatch 660 root:616 (cmd 85 → 901:0), /var/local writable. Root kit = patched Dropbear 2022.83 (fill_passwd, /etc/shells→/APPS/shell, password hash file because /etc/shadow is ro) on port 22; boot persistence via re_sshd in tv.vidaa.jsservice.basic/CHA/services + serviceList (ARMED ~30s after boot on four cold boots). Lane 3 native Home installed in the writable operation-ui app.js (component swap only), owner allowlist YouTube / Stremio Lite / TV Browser, 10 inputs kept; verified on screen and across reboot. OTA already off: /OAD/AppUpgradeSwitch.json upgradeFlag 0 (BIH) and /var/local/nightupdate.ini dcm_update=0. Verified boot green. Pairing/lane 1 not exercised; vendor tiles Netflix/Disney+/Prime/Rakuten/HBO Max/EON TV/Crunchyroll are store-feed rows, not installed packages. Teardown: kill the Dropbear pid; remove /APPS/.re_sshd, /APPS/installer.ipk and /APPS/shell; delete the FIREWALL_IN_EULAON dport 22 rule; restore serviceList.json.pristine and remove the re_sshd service directory; roll back operation-ui app.js from the stock backup. The rootfs is never written (squashfs ro, dm-verity green).
